testimonials.title: Hear from Our Learners
testimonials.subtitle: Success stories from students of all ages and backgrounds

items.name: University Student
items.content: The instructor has vast experience in Mathematics and explains exam problems effortlessly. If something isn't clear, he explains it in a way we can understand. He should continue teaching this way - there will be no problems at all.

items.name: Engineering Student
items.content: I liked the focus on practical examples and the emphasis on fundamentals from elementary and high school. That's where most confusion happens for students with weak prior knowledge.

items.name: FINKI Student
items.content: The method of teaching is appropriate, covering both theory for better understanding of context and logic, as well as practical problem-solving which is of utmost importance.

items.name: Mathematics Student
items.content: I really liked how the topics were covered and the type of problems that most frequently appear on exams, plus the 'hacks' we were taught for solving them. The teaching was dynamic with enough theory and enough practice problems.

items.name: University Student
items.content: Problem-solving in a simplified and understandable manner, and the explanation of the problems themselves is top-notch. The dedication to always being there to answer our questions or clarify a problem is excellent.

items.name: First Year Student
items.content: The guy is phenomenal. He should just keep it up! Friendly, knows how to explain, and is overall a cool guy. Great idea and execution. Excellent guys were chosen to explain the problems. Everything was super.

items.name: Student
items.content: Everything was great, just a bit more emphasis on things we need to know from elementary and high school. That's where the biggest confusion happens for students with weak prior knowledge. The organization is great and the material we cover in class is appropriate.

items.name: University Student
items.content: Great idea and execution. Excellent instructors were chosen to explain the problems. Overall the teaching was well structured, first with theory then with practical problem-solving which is a smart approach.

items.name: Student
items.content: It was great, dynamic. Enough theory, enough problems. The teaching method is appropriate, covering both theory for better understanding of context and logic, as well as practical problem-solving which is of utmost importance.

faqItems.question: How do I enroll in a course?
faqItems.answer: You can enroll by clicking the 'Enroll Now' button on any course page, or by contacting us directly through our contact form or phone.

faqItems.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqItems.answer: We accept bank transfers, cash payments, and installment plans. Contact us to discuss payment options that work best for you.

faqItems.question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee if you're not satisfied with the course content or teaching quality.

faqItems.question: Do you provide certificates upon completion?
faqItems.answer: Yes, all students receive a certificate of completion for successfully finished courses.

faqItems.question: What if I miss a class?
faqItems.answer: We provide recorded sessions and makeup classes. You can also schedule one-on-one sessions to catch up on missed content.

faqItems.question: Are there any prerequisites for advanced courses?
faqItems.answer: Yes, some advanced courses require foundational knowledge. Check the course details page for specific prerequisites.

enrollment.title: Course Enrollment and Payment
items: Course fees must be paid in full before the start date unless installment arrangements are made
Prices are listed in Macedonian Denars (MKD) and are subject to change
Registration is confirmed only after payment is received
Course materials and access are provided upon successful enrollment

attendance.title: Attendance and Participation
items: Regular attendance is expected for optimal learning outcomes
Students must notify instructors in advance of any absences
Makeup sessions may be available for missed classes
Disruptive behavior may result in removal from the course

refund.title: Refund Policy
items: Full refund available within 7 days of course start if not satisfied
50% refund available within the first 25% of course duration
No refunds after 25% of course completion
Refunds processed within 14 business days

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property

Students may not redistribute or share course content
Recording of classes requires explicit permission

Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the course
We do not guarantee specific learning outcomes or job placement

Payment information for course enrollment

howWeUse.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide and improve our educational services
Process payments and manage your account
Send you course updates and important notifications
Respond to your questions and provide customer support
Analyze usage patterns to enhance our platform

sharing.title: Information Sharing

Legal authorities when required by law
